annotations.title: Web search results: search the web for a query and get the top pages with title, URL and snippet as JSON

description: Search the web and get the top results as JSON: title, URL, a short snippet and the page age, from the Brave Search API. 1-20 results per call. Results are for the caller's immediate use only: no storing, resale or model training (Brave API terms). Upstream failures and exhausted daily capacity return 503, uncharged. Pair with /extract to read a result in full. Use when an agent needs current information or sources from the open web. Example: q=x402 payment protocol. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
